author: A Whiterun steward

#The Upturned Ship

Jorrvaskr is built like the hull of a ship turned over, because it was, once, or so the Companions say: the very ship Ysgramor sailed from Atmora, hauled up the hill and roofed over with sod.

I have examined the timbers. They are not that old. I have not said so to anyone inside.

#The Circle

The Companions take work for coin, from anyone, for anything honorable. They do not have a leader, they will tell you; they have a Harbinger, who advises. In practice, everyone listens to the Harbinger.

An inner Circle of the oldest Companions keeps to itself. They hunt at night, the townsfolk say. The townsfolk say many things.

#The Skyforge

Above the hall stands the Skyforge, older than the city, shaped like an eagle with its wings spread. Steel made there holds an edge like nothing else in Skyrim.

The Gray-Mane family has kept the forge for generations. They do not let anyone else touch it, and they do not explain why.
